cut.carve: Cut across the bones into strips, short side up.
cut.name: Short Ribs
cut.prep: Thick coarse salt 40 min before. Room temp. Never wash.
cut.pull_rule: Around 68°C and the bones show — probe-tender. It keeps cooking off the fire.
cut.rotate_rule: Do not touch for the first 20 min. Turn when the underside releases on its own.
signals: Meat pulls back off the bone

cut.carve: Slice against the grain, thumb-thick, across the strip.
cut.name: Sirloin Strip
cut.prep: Salt right before the fire. Thick cut, NY-strip shape.
cut.pull_rule: 55°C center for medium-rare before rest. Carry-over adds ~3°C.
cut.rotate_rule: Sear one side until it releases, then rotate a quarter turn for crosshatch.
signals: Edges curl up from the grate

cut.carve: Slice against the grain across the eye.
cut.name: Ribeye
cut.prep: Rest at room temp, salt it 30 min out.
cut.pull_rule: 57°C center. The cap should be tender, not wobbly.
cut.rotate_rule: Roll it on its fat edge for 1–2 min once the faces are seared.
signals: Cap feels soft yet springs back
Fat at the edge renders, starts to crisp

cut.carve: Along the fibers first, then slice across — it needs the cross-cut.
cut.name: Skirt Steak
cut.prep: Dry it well, salt both sides just before fire.
cut.pull_rule: Springy to the poke, 55°C. It tightens quickly past that.
cut.rotate_rule: One fast sear per side. Thin cut: no fiddling.
signals: Crust forms fast — it is thin

cut.carve: Across the grain into wide fajita-style strips.
cut.name: Flank
cut.prep: The membrane side goes down first — leave its fat cap on.
cut.pull_rule: 60°C and the crust is a hard shell. Rest long.
cut.rotate_rule: Low heat, patient. Rotate for even browning, never rush it.
signals: Inside stays pink while outside darkens

cut.carve: Cut into individual ribs at the table.
cut.name: Whole Rib Rack
cut.prep: A full rack is a centerpiece — salt the fat side only.
cut.pull_rule: When the short bones bend and the meat sags — 70°C is done, not dry.
cut.rotate_rule: Indirect heat zone. Rotate the rack every 40 min, thin end toward the glow.

cut.carve: Separate thigh and leg at the joint.
cut.name: Chicken Quarters
cut.prep: Butterfly or press flat. Salt and olive oil before fire.
cut.pull_rule: 75°C at the thickest joint. Never serve pink near the bone.
cut.rotate_rule: Skin side away from the hottest coals first, flip when golden.
signals: Clear juices from the deepest poke

cut.name: Lamb Leg
cut.prep: Patagonian style: salt crust, rosemary optional.
cut.pull_rule: 62°C for pink middle, more if the crowd likes it done.
cut.rotate_rule: Rotate continuously over low coals, slow roast wins here.
signals: Leg pulls from the bone tip

cut.carve: Cut coins, then rest each coin against the grain.
cut.name: Rolled Flank
cut.prep: If rolled with stuffing, tie snug and cook indirect.
cut.rotate_rule: Rotate the roll a quarter turn every 10 min for even walls.

cut.carve: Angle-cut coins or split for a sandwich (choripán).
cut.name: Criollo Sausage
cut.prep: Place where embers are rippling, not roaring.
cut.pull_rule: No pink center — 70°C. Juicy means juicy, not raw.
cut.rotate_rule: Turn every 8 min, no piercing to "help the fat".
signals: Skin tightens, juices seep out visibly

cut.name: Blood Sausage
cut.prep: Do not prick it. Dark thin casing, low heat.
cut.pull_rule: Off the fire just before the skin gets ready to crack.
cut.rotate_rule: Turn gently with tongs — a split casing leaks everything.
signals: Tiny fat pearls on the skin

cut.carve: Slice thick, serve on warm bread.
cut.name: Sweetbreads
cut.prep: Whole — never cut them up before the fire.
cut.pull_rule: Dark crust, molten center. Undercooked inside is wrong — it must set.
cut.rotate_rule: Pressure with the spatula for an even crust, flip once.

cut.carve: Serve whole, salted at the table.
cut.name: Chitterlings
cut.prep: Best pre-boiled in salted water 30 min — the short path to tender.
cut.pull_rule: Snappy, not leathery. Low heat from then on.
cut.rotate_rule: High heat first, rotate until evenly coiled and curled.

cut.carve: Eat with the spoon straight off the board.
cut.name: Provolone Wheel
cut.prep: Slice 2–3 cm thick, oregano + pepper on top.
cut.pull_rule: Charr base, lava center. Slide off onto bread, do not flip.
cut.rotate_rule: Do not move it — the browned base is the point.
